concept.title: Local residents and community
concept.shortdesc: People defined by where they live or by belonging to the wider community, including volunteers and the organisations they work with.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : People who volunteer or want to volunteer, and the charities, community groups and other not-for-profit organisations that work with them.
: People who live in Dorset or its districts and postcodes, with a few similar phrases naming other local areas.
: People who live anywhere in Lancashire or one of its towns and rural areas, plus a few similar phrases naming North Lincolnshire.
: The whole community or any member of it, without restriction to a particular group of people.
